name: @markvspec/cli
description: Command line tools for validating and exporting MarkVSpec screen specifications.

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module";const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.test: npm run build && rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp package.json dist-test/package.json && node --test dist-test/test/**/*.test.js
